run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T13:55:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is best explained by the product-catalog dependency becoming unusable. At 13:53:24–13:53:32Z the Deployment product-catalog was updated to generation 4 with a new ReplicaSet (product-catalog-fcf7564cf) whose pod template overrides the container command to ["invalid-command"]; the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (no command override) was scaled to 0 and its pod deleted. The only new pod, product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, never started: last termination reason StartError, exit code 128, kubelet message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', now CrashLoopBackOff with 5 restarts and Ready=False; the product-catalog Service has no ready endpoints. Product-catalog span traffic fell from ~3,021 GetProduct spans per 5m to 0 after 13:53, and frontend error spans, which were 0 through the 13:54:06 evaluation, appeared in the 13:56:06 five-minute bucket (alert fired 13:55:06Z) and are confined to routes that call product-catalog: GET /api/products/{productId} with its grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct client span, GET /api/recommendations with ListRecommendations, and POST /api/checkout with CheckoutService/PlaceOrder. Frontend's cart and data paths show zero error spans. Checkout and recommendation also recorded their own error spans on calls to product-catalog starting in the same bucket, and frontend-proxy ingress/router error spans rose from ~1.1 per 5m to ~1,656 at the same evaluation. Exact gRPC status codes could not be confirmed because Jaeger returned no spans for these windows and application logs were empty.

claims.text: In the 69m window ending 2026-11-15T14:04:06Z, frontend recorded 13,145.43 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans (sum over all its operations), the largest error total of any service; frontend-proxy 6,933.40, recommendation 945.99, checkout 584.53, ad 2.05, while accounting, fraud-detection and payment returned 0.

frontend's own error spans are concentrated on product-catalog-dependent operations: server span GET /api/products/{productId} 2,451.20 and client span grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 2,451.20; GET /api/recommendations 468.27 with grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 468.27; POST /api/checkout 312.69 with grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 312.79; also server span GET 3,118.75, POST 312.69 and tcp.connect 17.32 errors.

frontend error spans were 0 at every 5m evaluation up to and including the 13:54:06Z point, then 2,427.47 in the bucket ending 13:56:06Z, rising to 5,623.47, 6,751.93, 6,564.44 and 5,305.27 through the 14:04:06Z evaluation — i.e. error onset between 13:54:06Z and 13:56:06Z, matching the alert start 13:55:06Z.

Deployment product-catalog is at generation 4 with spec.replicas 1, readyReplicas absent, unavailableReplicas 1, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog and container command ["invalid-command"].

Ownership chain: both ReplicaSets are owned by Deployment product-catalog; the old ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc has replicas 0 and no container command, while the new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf has replicas 1 and container command ["invalid-command"], so the bad command was introduced by this rollout rather than being pre-existing.

Events show the rollout and its failure: Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0 at 13:53:24Z with SuccessfulDelete of pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm, Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf from 0 to 1 at 13:53:32Z, then Warning Failed events with message 'failed to create containerd task: ... error during container init: exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' (count 6, last 13:56:45Z) and Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container product-catalog' (count 25, last 13:58:47Z) on pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, with the same Failed message earlier on pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf, startTime 2026-11-15T13:53:32Z) is Running but Ready=False with reason ContainersNotReady; container product-catalog has restartCount 5, state waiting CrashLoopBackOff with message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=product-catalog', and lastState terminated reason StartError, exitCode 128, finishedAt 2026-11-15T13:56:45Z. No liveness or readiness probe is defined on the container.
The product-catalog Service endpoints contain only notReadyAddresses (pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, ip 100.96.2.148) on port 8080 — there is no ready backend for product-catalog.

product-catalog stopped serving: per-5m GetProduct spans fell from 3,021.11 (bucket ending 13:54:06Z) to 1,618.89 (ending 13:56:06Z), 95.56 (ending 13:58:06Z) and 0 for buckets ending 14:00:06Z, 14:02:06Z and 14:04:06Z; ListProducts followed the same pattern (260 -> 137.78 -> 6.67 -> 0).

product-catalog itself recorded no error-status spans in the window: its only span series are oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (12,850.98) and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (1,101.40), both STATUS_CODE_UNSET, so the failure is a total absence of the pod rather than in-process errors it reported.

checkout's own error spans are limited to oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (292.27) and its client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (292.27), and they start in the same 5m bucket ending 13:56:06Z (84.00 after zero/absent before), sustaining 216.63, 301.90, 315.56 and 253.89.

recommendation's error spans are on /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (471.47) and get_product_list (471.47); its per-5m error rate was ~0-1.12 before and jumped to 138.19 in the bucket ending 13:56:06Z, then 368.93, 483.70, 482.22 and 411.97.

frontend-proxy error spans are on ingress (3,473.32) and router frontend egress (3,460.08) in the window, and its per-5m error total rose from a ~1.11-3.35 baseline to 1,656.67 in the bucket ending 13:56:06Z, then 3,332.22, 3,358.34, 3,344.44 and 2,705.33.

All other otel-demo deployments are 1/1 ready at generation 1 (including frontend and frontend-proxy), and product-catalog is the only one with READY <none>, UNAVAILABLE 1 and GEN 4; the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running, ready=true with restartCount 0.

frontend error spans are absent on the paths that do not call product-catalog: GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, /api/data, and client spans grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem all returned 0 error spans in the window, which argues against a frontend-wide failure.

Rejected: frontend's own deployment, config or process caused the error-rate alert. frontend is at generation 1 with 1/1 ready replicas, its pod has restartCount 0 and Ready=true, and its errors started only when product-catalog lost all ready endpoints while being confined to the product-catalog-dependent routes.

Rejected: the ad service errors are part of this incident. ad's only error spans are flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (2.05 over 69m) with flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean at 0, a flagd dependency unrelated to product-catalog and negligible in volume compared with frontend, checkout and recommendation errors.

The frontend and downstream error spans are gRPC/connection failures to product-catalog rather than product-level 404s, because product-catalog had no ready endpoint, its span traffic was 0, frontend recorded 17.32 tcp.connect errors, and 13,145 frontend error spans appear in ~11 minutes against product-catalog's previous 0 error spans. The exact gRPC status code is not verified: no Jaeger trace spans were returned and no log lines were readable.

Remove the container command override ["invalid-command"] from Deployment product-catalog (spec.template.spec.containers[0].command) so it uses the image's entrypoint, let the rollout complete, and confirm the new pod reaches Ready and the product-catalog Service endpoint gets a ready address before declaring recovery; then verify frontend error spans/rate return to the pre-13:53 baseline.

gaps: Jaeger returned no spans for frontend or product-catalog in every window tried (12:55-14:04Z and 13:50-13:54:49Z), although traces_list_services lists both services, so gRPC status codes, span error details and parent-child call edges could not be verified from traces.

Container logs were empty: product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l never started a process (no previous instance, no output), and frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 returned 0 log lines for 13:50-14:04:49Z, so no application-level error text is available.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what applied the command ["invalid-command"] to Deployment product-catalog at ~13:53Z, and whether other deployment generations preceded generation 4, is unknown.

The metrics named for gRPC/HTTP server instrumentation (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count, http_server_request_duration_seconds_count) returned no series in this target's Prometheus, so the alert's own RequestErrorRate expression and its 16.87 value could not be reproduced; error analysis relied on traces_span_metrics_calls_total, whose 'GET'/'POST' server spans carry no URL or HTTP status labels, so per-route request denominators and HTTP status codes are unknown.
No evidence ties the single fraud-detection restart or any other pod change to this incident; that restart is left unplaced.
next_steps: Confirm via change history or the deploying pipeline what applied the container command ["invalid-command"] to Deployment product-catalog, and roll it back.

After remediation, re-check Deployment product-catalog readyReplicas, Service product-catalog ready endpoints, product-catalog span traffic and frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate to confirm recovery (not executed in this Run).

Once Jaeger has spans for this window, inspect a failing trace of frontend grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct to record the exact gRPC status code (e.g. Unavailable/NotFound) and confirm the parent-child edge from frontend /api/products/{productId}.
